organizations.name: UO American Marketing Association
organizations.description: The American Marketing Association (AMA) Is a national organization with an active chapter at the University of Oregon. This club emphasizes professional development in the field of marketing offering competitions, workshops, networking events, and more to introduce students to the industry beyond the classroom. Site visits are held once a term where AMA members tour companies from Seattle to San Francisco to better understand the nature of the work.
